title: Boss part 4: the dock report

ticket.subject: Report lines
ticket.body: Each row is a (dock, total kg) pair, and each dock appears in one row. Return one line per row, sorted by dock name A to Z. Each line reads "dock: total", with the total to one decimal place.

rules: Each line reads "dock: total" with the total to one decimal place.
Lines are sorted by dock name, A to Z.
